mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.parking_lot_id, a.area_code, a.area_name, a.description, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_space s WHERE s.area_id = a.id) AS space_count FROM parking_area a WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_area (parking_lot_id, area_code, area_name, description, status) VALUES (#{parkingLotId}, #{areaCode}, #{areaName}, #{description}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_area SET area_name = #{areaName}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_record r JOIN parking_space s ON s.id = r.parking_space_id WHERE s.area_id = #{areaId} AND r.status = 'PARKING'
SELECT l.status FROM parking_lot l WHERE l.id = #{lotId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT l.status FROM parking_lot l JOIN parking_area a ON a.parking_lot_id = l.id WHERE a.id = #{areaId} FOR UPDATE OF l
